purpose: Define which records may be treated as NEE facts, dated observations, derived decision intelligence, or private overlays. The contract is enforced fail-closed by audit and future write paths; it does not rewrite the current graph.

system_of_record.name: NEE Knowledge Base
system_of_record.role: Durable evidence and canonical fact system of record
system_of_record.allowed_mutation_path: Existing governed ingestion and exact approval-bound release lifecycle only
system_of_record.derived_content_policy: Derived recommendations, POVs, hypotheses, and briefings do not become canonical facts through use or adoption.

canonical_fact.purpose: A proposition supported by governed source evidence and admitted to the canonical fact lane.
canonical_fact.answer_rule: Facts must carry source, as-of/currentness, audience, and confidence context. Missing or expired time evidence is not permission to infer current truth.

dated_observation.purpose: An immutable, dated observation about delivery, schedule, scope, capacity, readiness, adoption, value, dependency, or decision state.
dated_observation.answer_rule: Observations are append-only. A newer observation supersedes an older one; omission is not resolution. Expired observations resolve to STALE_OR_UNKNOWN.

derived_decision_intelligence.purpose: A bounded change brief, decision inbox item, readiness gap, dependency warning, meeting brief, POV, metric proposal, hypothesis, or recommendation.
derived_decision_intelligence.answer_rule: A derived answer must label itself as derived, state assumptions and uncertainty, expose counterevidence, and never upgrade itself to fact because a user accepted it.

private_overlay.purpose: PartnerAdvisory account strategy, personal coaching, career planning, or other restricted context that is not part of the NEE client knowledge base.
private_overlay.answer_rule: Private context can shape a private planning answer only when explicitly requested and authorized. It must never alter, rank, or contaminate client facts or client-facing recommendations.

flow_rules.rule: Canonical NEE facts may be used by derived intelligence only through explicit evidence links.
flow_rules.failure: Reject the derived artifact or mark it incomplete.

flow_rules.rule: Derived intelligence may not be stored as canonical current retrieval-eligible assertions.
flow_rules.failure: Fail the boundary audit and quarantine the artifact.

flow_rules.rule: A query scope may not combine client audiences with private or PartnerAdvisory-restricted overlay records.
flow_rules.failure: Fail closed with an audience boundary error.

flow_rules.rule: Confidential records may not be exposed to a client audience without explicit client-approved classification and provenance.
flow_rules.failure: Suppress the record and emit an audit event.

flow_rules.rule: Stale, missing, or conflicting observations resolve to STALE_OR_UNKNOWN or CONFLICT, never an inferred green state.
flow_rules.failure: Return the uncertainty state and the evidence dates.

flow_rules.rule: Private overlays are one-way context and cannot write back to the NEE Knowledge Base or change client-facing rankings.
flow_rules.failure: Reject the operation and record a policy violation.

next_wave_actions: Create explicit lane metadata and typed observation contracts.
Quarantine derived canonical assertions through an approval-bound migration proposal.
Add audience-isolation negative tests before any graph mutation.
Keep private overlay storage and retrieval out of the NEE Knowledge Base release path.

pass_conditions: Policy JSON parses and its audience registry is closed-world.
Boundary audit is reproducible against the exact active graph.
The audit reports current violations without rewriting them.
Active graph hash is unchanged before and after the audit.
